description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to establish Advance Technological Institutes of Batticaloa, Tangalle, Puttalam, etc.
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (A. Ibathul Rauff Hakeem, Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education) and detailed descriptions of the responsibilities and actions being taken (establishing Advanced Technological Institutes, assigning specific names, locations, departments, and divisions of study). The content involves the minister exercising powers under a specific act to create educational institutions with detailed structural specifications, making it a Hybrid gazette that combines both personnel and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
